# About

I am a Senior at Brigham Young University - Idaho with aspirations to obtain a PhD in Psychology. I have been proficient at data analysis and have placed in this portfolio all of my major projects over my years at BYUI.

## Statistical Projects

My minor is in Statistics and I have 2 years worth of projects in my different classes that I have compiled into this portfolio

## Research Projects

My major is Psychology and I have been obsessed with research since my freshman year. I have compiled 3 of my major projects with the data that I collectec, cleaned, and ran analyses on. I have also included some of my Literature Reviews in my Research Papers section
